# Wuffs (vendored)

`wuffs-v0.4.c` is the single-file C release of [Wuffs](https://github.com/google/wuffs)
(`release/c/wuffs-v0.4.c`, version 0.4.0-alpha.10+3966.20260623, fetched from
commit f31d952b62fcd8abcc8d42908284f50097313bc8). Wuffs is dual-licensed
Apache-2.0 / MIT: `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-APACHE`, `LICENSE-MIT` are its own files.

cctext compiles it in exactly one translation unit, `core/img_wuffs.c`, with
`WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULES` limited to the formats it reads (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP,
WebP, QOI and their dependencies) and every symbol static. Nothing else
includes it. Do not edit this file; replace it with a newer release instead.
